'''Morgan''' (Japanese: '''モーガン''' ''Morgan'') is a character in the Pokémon Adventures manga. He is a resident of [[Vaniville Town]] who works as a firefighter.

==History==
==={{MangaArc|X & Y}}===
Morgan debuts in ''[[PS574|Tying Trevenant]]''. He was one of the people who were kidnapped by [[Team Flare]] after attempting to escape from the destruction of Vaniville Town caused by the battle between [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] and {{p|Yveltal}}. Morgan and the other kidnapped Vaniville Town residents were taken to the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]], where they were locked inside jail cells.

When Team Flare began the operation to retrieve the dormant tree form of Xerneas, [[Celosia]] used her {{p|Aegislash}} to mind control the Vaniville townspeople in order to use them for slave labor. The townspeople were taken to {{rt|8|Kalos}}, where they were made to load Xerneas's tree form into a vehicle so that it can be moved to Team Flare's base. Morgan was freed from the mind control when [[Korrina]] battled against Celosia and defeated Aegislash with her {{TP|Korrina|Lucario}}.

Afterward, Morgan and the other Vaniville townspeople were taken to a [[Laverre City]] hospital to recuperate.

==Trivia==
* According to [[Satoshi Yamamoto]], several of the Vaniville Town residents are a reference to the long-running television series, {{wp|Criminal Minds}}. Morgan's design is a reference to the character {{wp|Derek Morgan (Criminal Minds)|Derek Morgan}}.<ref>[https://twitter.com/satoshi_swalot/status/1012299343255097344 Yamamoto's tweet]<sub>(Japanese)</sub></ref>
